name: Woodpecker CI
tagline: HTTP API for self-hosted CI pipelines, repos, and secrets
description: Woodpecker CI is a lightweight open-source continuous integration system (Drone fork lineage) that exposes an HTTP API for managing repositories, pipelines, secrets, and related resources on self-hosted instances. Developers authenticate with personal access tokens and call REST endpoints on their own server rather than a shared SaaS API host.

auth.details: Personal access token via Authorization: Bearer header (or token query param on some clients); generated in user settings on the self-hosted instance

pricing.free_tier_limits: Open-source self-hosted software; no SaaS API quotas—limits are your instance capacity
pricing.paid_plans: No official paid API tiers; optional commercial support/hosting may exist from third parties

use_cases: list repositories registered on a Woodpecker instance
trigger or re-run a pipeline for a repo
fetch pipeline and build status for CI automation
list recent pipeline runs and their steps
